snippet.title: Varsapura | Official Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Check out 31 minutes of gameplay from Varsapura, an upcoming title from HoYoverse, developed on Unreal Engine 5. 

The Varsapura gameplay video takes you into the mysterious Shadow Bureau and the organization SEAL, as we get a peek at combat as a new player, while using an umbrella weapon, embarks on a test in a fight against Shadow Monsters. We also get a glimpse at a stealth mission, along with the combat style of a secondary character who uses books to fight. The video also introduces us to Mr. Shadow, gives us a hint at the story, city exploration via vehicular transportation, and more.
